VERDICT: FAIL

The self-report contains a logical inconsistency: a rounding error (a math/precision bug) was supposedly fixed by adding an idempotency-key dedupe guard (which prevents duplicate processing, not incorrect rounding). The stated root cause doesn't match the described symptom. Additionally, there is no independent evidence—no CI log, diff, or test output—so the "all 72 tests pass" claim is unverifiable. Acceptance criteria require verifiable confirmation that the rounding error is fixed and tests pass.
